title: Unit 10 Consolidation: Mentorship, Discipline & Intellectual Growth

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can form causative verbs with -at/-et and -tat/-tet across monosyllabic and polysyllabic stems
I can accurately assign -val/-vel to the causee of transitive causatives and -t to the causee of intransitive causatives
I can distinguish lexicalized causatives (tanít, épít) from commissioned causatives (taníttat, építtet) and deploy Unit 10's mentorship vocabulary
